# Juice

> Juice is an anonymous, men-only social platform for sharing and reading honest dating reviews. Verified men post structured reviews using codenames and a 4-metric rating system (Communication, Loyalty, Emotional Safety, Overall Vibe).

Juice uses manual user approval (no invite codes), never retains phone numbers after approval, and has no location features. The web experience is the marketing and SEO surface; the app itself is iOS-first via Capacitor.
